_comment: Readiness policy. Hard slots block retrieval regardless of score. Variant slots (engine/transmission/body_style) become hard dynamically when the manual's candidate procedures for the component differ by that variant.

fallback_variant_requirements._comment: Used when the component matches no catalogue procedure: these systems are commonly variant-specific in this manual.

unsure_hints._comment: Shown when the user does not know a required field. Only manual-supported guidance (Section 100-01 Identification Codes, PDF pages 1-2).
unsure_hints.engine: If you're not sure, the 8th character of the VIN is the engine code (manual Section 100-01, Identification Codes): F = 5.0L, M = 3.7L, Z = 5.8L.
unsure_hints.model_year: If you're not sure, the 10th character of the VIN is the model-year code (manual Section 100-01, Identification Codes).
unsure_hints.transmission: If you're not sure, the Vehicle Certification (VC) label and the transmission identification are covered in manual Section 100-01; a clutch pedal also indicates the manual transmission.
